description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start\-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values\-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989\.
   

  

 Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full\-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Miratech is looking for a Workforce Management Product Manager to support the execution and continuous improvement of Workforce Management products and platforms. As part of a global customer\-focused organization, you'll contribute to the delivery of exceptional service experiences across customer care, finance, travel and lifestyle services, and operational support functions. Our teams combine technology, innovation, and process excellence to help customers get the most value from the products and services they use.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the Product Manager in executing the Workforce Management product roadmap.
* Partner with Operations, Technology, Analytics, and business stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into user stories and product features.
* Help prioritize the product backlog and support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and user acceptance testing.
* Coordinate delivery activities for platform enhancements, upgrades, and new functionality.
* Analyze workforce management processes and identify opportunities to improve forecasting, scheduling, staffing, and operational efficiency.
* Monitor product performance using KPIs and customer feedback to recommend enhancements.
* Assist with testing, implementation, release management, and adoption of new capabilities.
* Create process documentation, training materials, and communications to support successful product launches.
* Partner with vendors and internal teams to troubleshoot issues and support continuous platform improvements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for automation and process optimization.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in Product Management, Project Management, Workforce Management, Contact Center Operations, Business Analysis, or a related field.
* Exposure to Verint Workforce Management or other workforce optimization platforms.
* Familiarity with workforce management concepts such as forecasting, scheduling, capacity planning, or intraday management.
* Experience supporting contact center operations or workforce management functions.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies, including writing user stories and participating in backlog refinement and sprint planning.
* Experience gathering business requirements and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar Agile tools.


**Nice to Have**
* Knowledge of NICE, Nexidia, Calabrio, Genesys, or similar workforce optimization platforms.
* Familiarity with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or SQL.


**We offer:**
* Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year\-over\-year revenue growth.
* Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
* Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
* Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
* Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
* Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team\-building company social events.
* Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

title: Product Manager
description:
Responsibilities: 
 Growth Strategy Development: Develop and execute data-driven growth strategies across
the entire user lifecycle, from acquisition to retention and monetization.
 Experimentation & Testing: Design and implement A/B tests and other experiments to
validate growth hypotheses and optimize conversion rates. Analyze experiment results and
iterate on strategies based on data.
 Data Analysis & Insights: Deeply analyze user behavior data, identify growth trends and
opportunities, and develop actionable insights to inform product and marketing decisions.
 Product Optimization: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to identify and
prioritize product improvements that drive growth. Define product requirements and work
closely with development teams to ensure timely execution.
 Channel Optimization: Work with marketing teams to optimize marketing campaigns and
channels for user acquisition and engagement. Identify new and innovative channels for
growth.
 User Acquisition: Develop and execute strategies to acquire new users through various
channels, including organic, paid, and referral programs.
 User Retention: Develop and implement strategies to improve user retention and reduce
churn. Identify key drivers of churn and develop solutions to address them.
 Collaboration & Communication: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams,
including marketing, engineering, design, and analytics, to achieve growth objectives.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders regarding growth performance and strategy.
 Competitive Analysis: Stay up-to-date on industry trends and competitive landscape,
identifying opportunities to leverage best practices and differentiate our product.
 Growth Reporting: Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track key growth
metrics and provide regular updates on growth performance to stakeholders.
 
 
 Qualifications and Attributes we value: 
 Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics,
Statistics, Economics) from tier 1-2 colleges or equivalent practical experience.
 1+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on growth or marketing.
 Proven track record of driving significant growth in a product or business.
 Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Google Analytics,
Mixpanel).
 Experience with A/B testing and other experimentation methodologies.
 Deep understanding of user acquisition, retention, and monetization strategies.
 Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Passion for data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.

 We also provide cutting-edge and bespoke advertisement solutions for brands. Brands continue
